verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation that RUN itself lets an ops user offer health insurance plans, manage employee enrollments, or sync benefit deductions into payroll. The closest items are adjacent. One says payroll can be connected with benefits and 'other business tools', which describes integration with external tools. Another says experts can help set up 'benefits', which is setup assistance, not a documented health-insurance administration feature.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can offer and administer health insurance with enrollments and deductions synced to payroll
